accountDeletion.stm1: Deleting your account is a permanent action. Once you click on "Delete Account" your subscription with the platform will be immediately canceled, and all access to the platform will be permanently removed. You will no longer be able to read with us unless you reapply through a new evaluation interview, as if you were joining the platform for the first time. Please ensure this is the action you wish to take, as it cannot be undone.
accountDeletion.title: Account Deletion

evaluationTestGuidelines.st1: Ensure a suitable background without any distractions and with good lighting.
evaluationTestGuidelines.st2: Make sure to record in a quiet place without any noise or anyone else who might distract you.
evaluationTestGuidelines.st3: Make sure to dress appropriately and maintain a neat appearance.
evaluationTestGuidelines.st4: Sit in a proper posture, lift your head to face the camera, and ensure your mouth is directed towards the microphone.
evaluationTestGuidelines.st5: Use the camera and microphone test feature to ensure they are working properly.
evaluationTestGuidelines.st6: Press the record button and start reciting the verses that appear in front of you with proper Tajweed and at the highest level of accuracy you can achieve.
evaluationTestGuidelines.st7: After completing the recitation, press the stop recording button.
evaluationTestGuidelines.st8: You can listen to the recorded clip and re-record it if needed before sending it.
evaluationTestGuidelines.subTitle: Before the evaluation test
evaluationTestGuidelines.title: Guidelines and Instructions
